channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Wants Putin to End the War. He May Offer Russia Business Deals First.
item.description: A new sanctions bill is meant to pressure President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia to end the war in Ukraine. But President Trump is doubling down on a different approach: offering enticements to Russia.

item.title: NPR: Judge says Trump can't demolish Kennedy Center. And, lawsuits target voter intimidation
item.description: A federal judge ruled yesterday that President Trump cannot tear down the Kennedy Center without a 30-day notice. And, recent lawsuits seek to keep armed federal officers away from polling sites.

item.title: BBC News: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
item.description: The failure led to more than 2,000 flights being cancelled and hundreds of thousands of passengers affected.

item.title: The Guardian: Could AI really end humanity? Post your questions for our tech reporters now
item.description: After a week of alarming warnings about the technology’s potential to destroy the world as we know it, our expert tech reporters will take your questions on the reality of the AI threat. Join us at 3pm BST (4pm CEST, 10a…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Ronaldo keeps Portugal place for Nations League as Jesus names first squad
item.description: Ex-Manchester United and Real Madrid forward Cristiano Ronaldo named in Portugal squad to face ⁠Norway and Denmark.

item.title: Ars Technica: RFK Jr. names 8 new members to influential preventive medicine task force
item.description: The USPSTF sets insurance coverage from preventive services, like colonoscopies.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Why the Postpandemic Tech Bust Sent Billionaires to Trump
item.description: Following mass layoffs in 2022 and 2023, many tech workers turned against their employers. When liberal politicians also rallied against Silicon Valley, their backers turned to Donald Trump.

item.title: WIRED Science: He Won the Nobel Prize for Protein Design. Now He Uses AI to Create Molecules Not Found in Nature
item.description: David Baker spoke with WIRED en Español about where biological design is headed next and the great potential and risks of taking biology outside the bounds of the natural world.

item.title: WIRED Business: Submit Your Questions: Why Is Silicon Valley Still a Boy's Club?
item.description: How are women really faring in Silicon Valley? Submit your questions to our panel and we'll give you the scoop.

item.title: The New Yorker: Why China Isn’t Getting Existential About A.I.
item.description: China’s fears about the technology are increasingly distinct from those of the U.S. What does that mean for international coöperation?

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Greta Gerwig Had a Good Reason to Cast Meryl Streep as Aslan
item.description: “I wanted someone who was older than 70, so there was a wisdom of experience, but who also had the capacity of fresh wonder, like a child.”

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: What Is Rostam Batmanglij’s NYQ?
item.description: On a scale from Carnegie Hall to Lerner Hall, where does the musician and producer fit?
